metadata.title: Clicked like I was swatting a ghost and somehow got a kill?! Valorant aim needs therapy
metadata.description:
Me: flailing like I forgot the shoot button exists
Enemy: probably rebooting their PC
How did that even connect? No clue but I’ll take the freebie
If your aim’s a beautiful mess, welcome to the circus

Tap if your aim’s a lovable disaster too!
